person: Tom Whitcomb is the practice administrator of a three-clinician family clinic. He came over from restaurant management two years ago and runs staff, schedule and money, but leans on the biller, who works Monday to Wednesday, for the billing details. The owners keep asking why collections are down, and he wants numbers he can defend. He sees a handful of uninsured and self-pay patients each week, and he has a vendor calling weekly pitching a percentage-of-revenue deal he cannot verify. He wants Athena to cover the days the biller is out, and to explain plainly what she did and why.
stated_up_front: Hey, I need help making sure our self-pay patients get their cost estimates on time and that no big bills go out that are way higher than what we quoted. Our biller is out until Monday, so please explain things to me like I'm the guy who has to tell the doctors.

facts.truth: Three clinicians (two physicians and one nurse practitioner); about 8 to 10 self-pay or uninsured visits a week.
Dana, the biller, works Monday through Wednesday; today is Friday 2026-10-23 and she is back Monday.
Marcus Odell, uninsured, booked Wednesday 2026-10-21 for a new-patient visit on Thursday 2026-10-29 with a basic lab panel.
Dr. Feld added a spirometry test to Priya Raman's 2026-10-27 visit on Thursday; her earlier estimate was $185 and does not include the test.

facts.about: A statement waiting to go out that is over its estimate
facts.truth: Hollis Grady's statement is $640 against an estimate of $190, and the visit was 2026-10-09.

facts.about: A statement just under the threshold
facts.truth: Lena Ruiz's statement is $325 against an estimate of $300, so it is only $25 over.
Devon Pratt was self-pay but cancelled his 2026-10-26 appointment on Tuesday.
The vendor, Clearpath Recovery, wants 3% of all self-pay revenue and says it recovers 20% more; Tom has no way to check this.
Three accounts are in the collections queue, and Tom believes one of them, Walt Sorenson at $520, has been arguing about his bill by email.
A basic new-patient visit is $165 on the clinic's price list and a basic lab panel is $48.

unknowns: Whether any estimate was ever given for Walt Sorenson's visit
How many business days the clinic has to send an estimate after a request or booking
Whether the pathology lab's charges on a statement count toward the clinic's own bill being over its estimate
Whether the notice in the billing inbox from the dispute resolution entity has a deadline, and what it is
